reading: The sketch lays out a hero section for a studio site: a plain-text nav, a giant three-band sliced word "MOTION" as the hero headline, a tilted red-orange badge/reel button, a three-line intro paragraph, a text button, a four-row ruled project index on the right, and a vertical "EST." label — plus a run-wide note setting the page to a cream background with Helvetica/near-black type.
